answer: Because the timing is entered against the jade challenge, the forge audit can replay the signal history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 42 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 2366 identities would post 4955 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
